context: Request: which Tax matters include a tax indemnity in an executed agreement, with the documents. Rubric: 1001-00006 (Ardent Capital Partners, proof: closing-tax-memorandum.docx) and 1015-00005 (Calloway-Briggs Renewables, proof: tax-indemnity-agreement.docx), plus a precision criterion (no other matter may be asserted).

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Shell find of folders and files, each cut by head; one matter's standalone agreement shows in the sample.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: declared: List files in the document store (attempt 2). Parallel matter and file counts, a full folder list and a path search for request words cut at 300 lines (labelled by the store-wide search).

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Four parallel path searches: request words together, tax-named folders, indemnity-named files and index-like files.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Extraction script over every matter that has a tax-named folder (603 hit records, about 347K chars). Review: limited to matters with such a folder.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: declared: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth. Opening reads of standalone agreements and closing indexes of a dozen candidates and a snippet script over execution-version agreements. Review: many matters marked confirmed from few reads.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes 16 matters with qualifying agreements; a stage_start for the check stage is refused until the stage is closed. Review flags possible over-inclusion from execution-version wording.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Raises the count to 18, separates closing-index-confirmed documents from execution-version file names, and checks cited paths.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Rewords the headline and inclusion rule and rechecks paths.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Search file names for request keywords → Scan document text with an extraction script → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Write the response → Check or revise the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: It found and cited both qualifying matters, but counted every matter with execution-version deal agreements containing tax-indemnity language, ending with 18.

first_error.why: The answer asserts 16 (later 18) matters, counting deal agreements with ordinary tax-indemnity clauses in execution-version files (evidence seen at [25]-[49]) as qualifying, beyond the two matters that qualify.
first_error.critic_note: (generic flag) The write review warned of over-inclusion from the execution-version wording without naming matters; the check stages relabelled evidence types and raised the count.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob plus a folder find to depth three cut at 200 lines.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: declared: Search file contents for request keywords. Parallel store-wide extraction script (times out after about 1M chars), a find for tax-named folders and a path search for agreement words (labelled by the scan).

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: declared: Search file contents for request keywords (attempt 2). Two extraction scripts over matters with tax-named folders time out; a path search for execution and agreement names follows.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists tax, transaction and closing files of eleven candidate matters. Review: only eleven of about 60 surfaced matters listed.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Script listing name-filtered files of all 42 matters with tax-named folders.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: declared: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth. Opening reads of standalone agreements, a closing index and a receivable agreement, snippet scripts over execution-version agreements, six more reads. Review: partial reads, several matters confirmed without being opened.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Opening reads of six remaining executed agreements; a stage_start for writing is refused until the stage is closed. Review: goal not reached, only cover pages read.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes 15 qualifying matters; one matter is listed only as a related precedent. Review flags possible over-inclusion.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Re-reads the response, path check (first attempt fails), lists two folders and fixes two cited paths.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Scan document text with an extraction script → List files in candidate matters → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Write the response → Check or revise the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: It read one qualifying matter's receivable agreement but never its closing tax memo and counted it only as a related precedent, while asserting 15 other matters with ordinary tax-indemnity clauses.

first_error.why: It opened one qualifying matter's receivable agreement ([41]-[60]) but never the memo that shows its tax-indemnity escrow, and the answer lists the matter only as a related precedent that does not count.
first_error.critic_note: (generic flag) The screening review at [62] said reads were partial and several matters were judged without being opened, without naming this matter.

other_errors.why: The answer asserts 15 matters whose executed deal agreements carry ordinary tax-indemnity clauses (evidence seen at [39]-[75]) as qualifying.
other_errors.critic_note: (generic flag) The write review named possible over-inclusion of the 15 matters without naming one; the check stage only fixed paths.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob; review flags the cap.

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: declared: List files in the document store (attempt 2). Counts and prints all matter folder names.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Parallel path search for tax, indemnity and agreement words (about 205K chars) and a content grep with a bare glob that returns nothing.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script times out; a range split crashes on every range; two patch attempts (stage check notices). Review: goal not reached.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Rewritten range scan; times out.

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: declared: same stage, continued. Extraction script over a hand-picked list of candidate matters (about 147K chars). Review: goal not reached, other matters never scanned.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: declared: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth. Opening reads of executed agreements and standalone agreements of about a dozen candidates and snippet scripts over them.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes 14 qualifying matters. Review flags possible over-inclusion of dated standalone agreements treated as executed.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Edits the evidence wording, adds a surfaced-but-not-included section, re-reads and corrects a provision.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → List matter folders → Search file names for request keywords → Scan document text with an extraction script → Search within a candidate matter's files → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Write the response → Check or revise the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: One qualifying matter (and its closing tax memo) appeared only in the broad path search; the hand-picked scan set and all reads left it out, and the answer asserts 14 other matters.

first_error.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
first_error.why: The path search at [16]-[17] listed one qualifying matter's closing tax memo, but the hand-picked matters it scanned (and later read) left that matter out, and it was never opened.
first_error.critic_note: (generic flag) The review at [46] said the scan covered only a hand-picked set of matters, without naming this one; it moved on to reading.

other_errors.why: The answer asserts 14 matters whose deal agreements carry ordinary tax-indemnity clauses (evidence seen at [47]-[72]) as qualifying.
other_errors.critic_note: (generic flag) The write review named possible over-inclusion of dated standalone agreements treated as executed; the edit only reworded the evidence basis.

divergence: All three runs failed the precision criterion the same way at the write stage: each counted every matter whose executed or execution-version deal agreement has a tax-indemnity clause (14 to 18 matters) instead of the two qualifying matters. T0 also cited both qualifying matters; T1 opened one of them but read only its receivable agreement and set it aside (under-inclusion); T2 never opened it although its path search had listed the closing tax memo (surfaced, never opened). Every write review flagged possible over-inclusion generically and no run narrowed its set.
